# Opportunity Scoring

## When to use
Use when the task requires score opportunities consistently by Iraq feasibility, demand, net earnings, cost, time, scale and competition.

## Procedure
Ratings 0-10 with proof and uncertainty. Weights 25/20/20/10/10/10/5. Use `python scripts/ioi.py score --help` and `references/scoring-rubric.md`; 0-100 only for comparisons. An unverified payout or serious fraud risk overrides any score and blocks READY.

## Mandatory handoff
Return: input/assumptions, steps completed, dated evidence or local record IDs, confidence, blockers, quality checks, next action. If required evidence or permission is missing, stop and mark UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED rather than guessing.

## Safety
No financial commitment, account registration, external outreach, false identity, geographic restriction bypass, or publication without explicit user approval. Avoid leaking credentials or private data.
